name: OneStop
long_description: onestop is the local social network: what's going on a few blocks from you, posted by the people who are there. Invite-only on iOS and Android, starting in New York from Hell's Kitchen.
one_liner: The local social network: what's going on a few blocks from you.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Co-founder & CEO @ onestop, the local social network (onestop.so).

Before onestop, I managed global AI transformation at McKinsey. I studied at MIT with research in data and analytics, where I was also an MIT human rights and technology fellow.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio:
Co-Founder & CTO @ OneStop (onestop.so)

Prior to Interface: Quant Dev at Citadel building real time risk infra and analytics. From low-latency ETL to market simulations for Commodities and Fixed Income.

Before Citadel I studied Electrical Engineering & Computer Science at MIT where I did both my undergrad and masters with a concentration in distributed and embedded system development.
